Official names without a verified foreign-language name are preserved. Unknown prices, admission conditions and end times are not fabricated.
The October 17–18 Workstation applications are already closed, explicitly labelled as such rather than accepting new registrations.
Evening guided walks announced for January 2027 are included because the same official dated notice confirms them; no annual recurrence is assumed.
